## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `CreateAnEnvironment`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `create`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **CreateAnEnvironment**.

## Step 2: Create an environment

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to [WSO2 Cloud](https://console.devant.dev). -->
2. In the top navigation menu, select **Organization** list and select your organization. This opens the organization home page.
3. In the left navigation menu under **Admin**, select **Environments**.
4. Select **+ Create**. This opens the environment creation page.
5. <!-- manual: Configure the environment using the following fields: :::tip You can mark multiple environments as production. This is useful for multi-region deployments where you maintain independent production environments in different regions. ::: -->
6. Select **+ Create**.
